Survey Java files in /Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G013_keycloak for mechanical refactoring opportunities. First list files in these directories, then read the most promising ones. Report concrete findings: exact file path, line number, current code snippet, suggested replacement, and reason.

Focus only on clear, safe, mechanical improvements:
- deprecated API usage (URLEncoder/URLDecoder with String charset, getBytes("UTF-8"), new String(bytes, "UTF-8"))
- boxed types where primitives suffice
- StringBuffer → StringBuilder
- redundant else after return/throw
- isBlank() vs trim().isEmpty()
- Objects.equals()/hashCode() for verbose null-guard ternaries
- try-with-resources for manually closed streams
- unnecessary intermediate variables before return
- redundant modifiers (public on interface default methods, static on nested enums)
- @FunctionalInterface on single-abstract-method interfaces
- StandardCharsets vs string charset names
- diamond operator on raw generics
- contains() vs indexOf()!=-1
- isEmpty() vs equals("")
- anonymous class → lambda for @FunctionalInterface types
- replaceAll(literal) → replace(char/str)
- chaining calls to remove pointless reassignments

3. saml-core-api/src/main/java/org/keycloak/saml/ (list, pick 2-3 files)
